message: 乾いた風にかき消される

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. Unfortunately, the water meter is still showing abnormal readings.」

name: Synn
message: 「Our grand water-saving operation...」
Despite all their hard work, the incident remained completely unresolved.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President! If we give up now, it will tarnish the Student Council's name.」

name: Synn
message: 「If the Student Council loses credibility, it gets disbanded and I get expelled. Then I'll go underground, live off my own currency, and score the Tokugawa buried treasure!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's no way buried treasure like that actually exists!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it is~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't turn away from reality, Mr. President!」
Lolotte just hit me with a completely valid point...

name: Synn
message: 「You're totally right! Helena-san... Please, give us one more--just one more chance!!」

name: Helena
message: 「This is your last chance. A second failure will not be tolerated. You understand what that means, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*... Y-Yes, ma'am! We'll definitely nail the culprit」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We'll do our best to live up to BOSS's expectations!」

name: Helena
message: 「OK! I wish you success」
Toward a swift resolution of the incident, three special investigators were deployed to the scene.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going home」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You can't, Azel-san. At this point, we're all jointly responsible.」

name: Synn
message: 「If wasteful spending isn't the cause, there has to be another reason. We have to find it...」

name: Azel
message: 「You're desperate」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's only natural when our lives are on the line.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since when were our lives on the line!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, Mr. President. Let's give it all we've got.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... Lolotte, working so hard for my sake... thank you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A grand investigation to uncover the truth behind the case. Doesn't that just get your heart racing?」

name: Synn
message: 「What about my life...?」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph」
He laughed at me.

name: Synn
message: 「The water comes out just fine. Nothing out of the ordinary, huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The shower isn't broken either~」

name: Synn
message: 「It's peaceful... For some reason, I deeply despise this peace!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Peace is a wonderful thing, you know♪」

name: Azel
message: 「A false peace」

name: Synn
message: 「It is precisely because this chaotic world is filled with suspicion and malice that cruel incidents occur」

name: Azel
message: 「Filthy」

name: Synn
message: 「However, if I solve them...!」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no need for that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, I've spotted a suspicious figure of some sort」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's calm down, President. That person over there is a nun, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「O-oh, right. Yes, she is」
She is watering the surrounding plants that make up the beautiful scenery.

name: Synn
message: 「She seems to be humming a tune quite pleasantly」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's almost contagious, hmm-hmm-hmmm♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Grating」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How mean!!」
Unbothered by their strict surveillance, the cheerful nun finished watering and went back inside the church.
Seizing that brief opening, we made a mad dash!

name: Synn
message: 「Faucet, check」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nothing was left untightened!」
In that case, the only remaining reason I can think of is that a water pipe is broken.

name: Synn
message: 「It can't be helped...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President... what's with that shovel...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm digging it all up! And checking the water pipes!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't, Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't stop me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you give up here, everything will be over!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because the game has only just begun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it was just a game to you...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, you wouldn't... right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested」
I follow the direction of the gaze she abruptly turned away.
And what we saw there was--

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-A-A Demon!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shhh」
Whether it hasn't noticed us or simply doesn't care, it shows zero signs of being on guard.
It walks straight over to where the water tap is and twists the faucet open all the way.
And then it catches the water with its own body.

name: Synn
message: 「Cold-water ablutions? Or is it trying to take a shower?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Quite energetic considering it's been getting cold」

name: Synn
message: 「That's weird. With that much water running, there should be at least a little trace left behind...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-P-P-Mr. President! Look at that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa」
The endlessly flowing water turns into vapor and evaporates the instant it touches the Demon's body.
I couldn't make sense of it at first glance, but that body is carrying heat. And it's radiating an immense amount of it, too.
I don't know the reason, but I can't just overlook such wasteful consumption.

name: Synn
message: 「I see. We've finally tracked down the culprit.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's dangerous, so please stay hidden, Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「He's already gone...」
The two of us leap out in front of the demon.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come quietly and let us tie you up~」

name: Synn
message: 「If you cooperate and listen to what we say, we won't get rough with you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!」
A fireball came flying at us. Pretty gutsy to declare war like that.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」
